notes.title: BIG UPDATE!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Turns are more classic, now there is a pause when it is player 1's turn.
[*] A special bar was added for consecutive hits
[*] The shock of hits was removed when performing the super attack, now it is direct.
[*] Bugs were fixed for special movements
[*] The life increase card has a random amount.
[*] 
[/list]

[b]In SURVIVOR MODE[/b]

[list]
[*] Leveling up grants an improvement in the 3 skills randomly, black cards are no longer chosen.
[*] The life bug was fixed
[*] Stats increases such as life increase, more hits, more hit strength when facing bosses appear on the map and are deactivated when a boss is defeated. These cards appear in random places.
[*] Stats are shown when pause is set.
[*] The controls can be chosen in 4 configurations.
[*] Slime and Ariel's projectiles are custom (Each character will have a custom ability in the future)
[/list]

Sorry for being so late in updating and fixing some things, but I'm working on a lot of extra work.

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Added new special moves to:
Haruky and Jen: Perform a taunt by lowering player2's power bar.
Meilen and Bug: Change the turns in your favor.
J: Activates critical hits for a certain time, recharges.
Lime: Throws poison on the ground for a while, depletes the enemy's life, recharges.
Black and Ariel: Having less than 50% You can activate life recovery until you fill the maximum life with which you started the fight, it only activates 1 time per fight.
BigBen: Activates super defense, the enemy's blows become very weak, it also lasts for a while, it is rechargeable.
[/olist]

Adjusted HARD difficulty, and fixed BIGBEN's super animation appearing inverted.

notes.title: Small update and next report
notes.content:
There was a bug with the position of HARUKY player 2, fixed and a button.
I haven't been able to do anything lately due to lack of time, but I'm already catching up.
Upcoming updates:
New Special for each character, they affect differently.
Choose 2 or 3 control locations (buttons, you will no longer be able to enter the button you want, there will be predefined ones).
I will add a blood mode instead of the flash of the blow appearing blood (black color) and it will be activated by code or cheat whatever you want to call it.
Well thank you all, if you find any bug, please report it.

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can disable and enable by "1" key the flash when charging power
[*] Now you can raise life without a cap of 1200
[*] Added a much louder sound when doing a CRITICAL HIT.
[*] Fixed health stat display when acquired (previously added to remaining health during battle)
[*] Now the variables are reset the necessary ones, before they were all reset.
[*] The loop was fixed if we lost a battle, when choosing the character again, the variables now work well and the character goes down to the gnome, to go back up and fight with each one.
[*] Fixed the amount of turns needed to reach maximum energy.
[*] If you lose you don't have to go back to options to change settings, they remain stable.
[/list]


[b]Note[/b] Function keys
"1" Enable or disable Flashes
"Esc" Exits the game directly
"F" Activate non-scalable full screen.
